title: $T_{E,\Qlb}$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$, a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and a
bounded constructible complex $K$ of $E_X$-modules ([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), the
complex $T_{E,\Qlb}K$ ([def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar]) is a bounded constructible complex of
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$-modules.

proof.text: Apply the already proved generic exact scalar-extension preservation theorem to the actual coefficient inclusion. Its sole extra hypothesis, preservation of finite limits, is the coefficient flatness instance. The generic theorem tensors finite presentations after raw inverse image, retains their covers and stratification, and uses the exact-derived homology comparison to retain the original cohomological bounds.

proof_origin.place: Exactness, local presentations and boundedness, specialized through the existing proved generic theorem.
